sn52.1:1.2: Anuruddha was the brother of Ānanda and Mahānāma ([pli-tv-kd17:1.1.3]()) which, according to the commentary, makes the Buddha his cousin. In this Saṁyutta he appears as an exponent of mindfulness meditation; he is well known also as a master of clairvoyance ([an1.192:1.1]()). Many Suttas feature him, and his verses at [thag16.9]() give further details of his home life, his practice, and his past lives.
sn52.1:3.1: Here Anuruddha extends the basic _satipaṭṭhāna_ formula to include both internal/external and origination/vanishing.
